envelope.author: HostRuntimeConfigKept
envelope.reason: a finding beside the unit's path
envelope.cause: host-runtime-config-kept: carrying the host's keys made the unparseable case the one remaining way the host's content is replaced

payload.title: install replaces an unparseable runtime config unread
payload.body: emitRuntimeConfig (packages/forge/src/deploy/runtime-config.ts, priorConfig) reads a runtime config that is not valid JSON, or not an object, as empty, so a deploy rewrites it whole and the host's bytes are lost; uninstall (removeRuntimeStanza) by contrast leaves such a file unread and says nothing. host-runtime-config-kept carried every key of a parseable config and left this as it was; whether a deploy should refuse, or report, an unreadable config is not decided.
